ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Point $C$ is on line segment $AB$, point $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$, $AM=1$, $BC=4$. If point $N$ is the midpoint of $BC$, what is the length of $MN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$, $AM=1$,\\
$\therefore CM=AM=1$,\\
Since point $N$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $BC=4$,\\
$\therefore CN=\frac{1}{2}BC=2$,\\
$\therefore MN=CM+CN=1+2=\boxed{3}$;
